CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2822 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 204ffce804bbf0f602ad258b42c6fea0c9ddbf15. Bus nonce: 3ac21dce537c5c1da2d95df4bb916978. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 204ffce804bbf0f602ad258b42c6fea0c9ddbf15`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 204ffce804bbf0f602ad258b42c6fea0c9ddbf15` or `Fix review: blocked 204ffce804bbf0f602ad258b42c6fea0c9ddbf15 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 3ac21dce537c5c1da2d95df4bb916978`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `204ffce804bbf0f602ad258b42c6fea0c9ddbf15` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2822 204ffce804bbf0f602ad258b42c6fea0c9ddbf15") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2822-3ac21dce`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Review #2822 (triage batch 26, dev/programme/triage/s6-batch26.md, rulings P127 to P139) against dev/governance/roles/proposal-triage.md. For each ruling check: the verdict word (ACCEPT names a destination; DEFER names what changes the answer or the owning group; REJECT names the binding cost); `Source:`, `Instances:` (every counted instance carries the command or log reference beside its figure, and you re-run or re-derive at least one per ruling), `Cost:`, `Binding:`, and the carry text.
Routing (the main check): for every ACCEPT, read the roster at origin/main (dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json) and confirm the destination group is OPEN: it exists, is not done, not absorbed, and no pull request of it is merging, carries a MERGE verdict or sits in the merge-train spool (list open PRs and the spool). Confirm the destination owns the file the ruling says it owns by that group's files list. A carry to a done or closing group is a block (carry-dest-done). P130 re-chains the programme tail and P131 corrects the plan model's inputs: verify the roster edits they describe against the roster, and that the re-chain does not orphan a dependent. P133 changes what releases dependents: check no group is released early.
Facts: verify every factual claim in each ruling at file:line at this head. Quote the line you read. A ruling whose claim the code refutes is a block (ruling-refuted).
Also check: the body's verdict figures match the file; the pull request changes only the batch file and its delivery row (the row was added at this head by a ROW-ONLY push, 204ffce8); no host or home path appears. Say merge or blocked.
No host or home paths in anything you push; cite repo-relative paths only.
